verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a public REST API at docs.honeybadger.io/api, so agents can both read and drive the product through it. It covers reading data (listing faults or fetching a single fault for a project) and pushing data in (exceptions to /v1/notices, source map uploads, deployment notifications). Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths 404), evidence of broader management endpoints such as resolving faults or managing projects and teams, and independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.
